name: PIN_Authorized_Emergency_Management_Template
description: An operational tool designed to give supervisors immediate control over the contact center's emergency status. This script allows authorized users to dial into a secure flow, validate their identity via a 4-digit PIN, and toggle a global 'Emergency' flag. Once activated, all production flows automatically detect the status change and redirect callers to emergency announcements or alternative routing, ensuring consistent communication during service disruptions.
